name: Set
cue: Secure your feet at the raised end of a decline bench and cross your arms.

name: Curl
cue: Curl your shoulders and torso off the bench.

name: Sit up
cue: Bring your chest toward your knees while keeping your feet secured.

name: Control
cue: Pause without pulling on your neck.

name: Lower
cue: Uncurl your torso toward the bench with control.

name: Reset
cue: Return to the extended position without slamming.
